title: Design System: Trip Planner for Claude

subtitle.purpose: Card names, day names, the hidden-gem heading.

label.purpose: Field labels, legends, chip, segment and tab text.

note.purpose: Hints, notes and footer text in steel.

data.purpose: Brief-line values and other trip data in mono.

data-small.purpose: Score badge, currency suffix, step numbers.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Under the yellow primary button on hover, with a 2px rise. Nothing has a shadow at rest.

shadows.name: lift-link
shadows.purpose: The dashboard link button's smaller copy of the hover lift.

gradients.name: ground
gradients.purpose: Page ground, fixed to the viewport. The radial glow moves to 0 -10% under RTL.

gradients.name: rail-wash
gradients.purpose: Lighter wash at the top of the summary rail.

motion.name: out
motion.purpose: The one easing for anything that moves: button lift, chip press, checkmark, brief-line draw, result rise, bar growth.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on hover, selection and focus.

motion.name: brief-light
motion.purpose: A brief-line row lighting up when its fields are filled; the underline draws from the inline start.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: The result block entering the rail after the prompt is created.

motion.name: done-hold
motion.purpose: How long the copy button stays flag blue with the Copied label.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to everything under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action of the form: create or copy the prompt. Full width at the end of the rail.

components.name: Link Button and Ghost
components.description: Dashboard booking link and its secondary ghost variant.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, field-navy input, yellow focus ring and caret.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Count field with minus and plus buttons in one bordered control; the number is mono.

components.name: Chips
components.description: Multi-select pills: dim until chosen, then lit yellow.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem}.ds-chip{position:relative}.ds-chip input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;margin:0;pointer-events:none}.ds-chip span{display:block;padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--line,#1E2E57);border-radius:99px;background:var(--field,#0C1A38);color:var(--steel,#8FA3C7);font-family:"Tajawal","Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s,transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-chip span:hover{border-color:var(--line-hi,#566BA3);color:var(--ink,#F3F6FC)}.ds-chip span:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-chip input:checked+span{background:var(--crane,#E9C46A);border-color:var(--crane,#E9C46A);color:var(--on-crane,#1A1405)}.ds-chip input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--flag,#8DB4FF);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Page-wide preference (language, currency). The one selection that stays navy.

narrative.overview:
This is the web rendition of Rayen's carousel world: a night-navy ground with one blue glow in a top corner, cool grey-blue text, and a single calm yellow. Everything sits dim until it means something. A chip is dim until chosen, a brief-line row is dim until its field is filled, a card is quiet until it is the recommendation. Then it lights yellow. The same yellow carries the one action on screen.

The system covers two surfaces that share one token set: the trip-brief form (a two-column checkout shape, form on one side and a sticky summary rail ending in one button on the other) and the travel dashboard (a destination hero, a sticky tab bar, then tables and cards). Both are dark only, flat, and dense enough to read as a tool: 1px lines, tonal layers, generous field height, no decoration that does not carry state.

Words are set in Tajawal in both scripts. JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is trip data or the prompt itself: route, dates, prices, counts, scores, times.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: night-navy ground, three close tonal layers (ground, panel, field) separated by 1px navy lines.
One yellow, used for "set", "picked" and "act". One blue for focus, links, live-price tags and the copied state.
Two fonts with a hard split: Tajawal for language, JetBrains Mono for data.
Flat at rest. A shadow appears only when a yellow button lifts on hover.
Built for both directions: every offset is a logical property and the directional details mirror in RTL.
Motion is state feedback with an expo-out curve; all of it switches off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Lit Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a state, not a decoration. It means set, picked, or act. An element that is none of those stays navy and steel.

rules.name: The Dark Text On Light Fill Rule
rules.body: Any yellow or flag-blue fill takes `on-crane` text. Ink and body never sit on a filled accent.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: One radial blue glow per page, in the top corner at the inline end, fixed to the viewport. No second glow, no glow under components.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for trip data and the prompt text: numbers, dates, times, prices, routes, scores, counts, the handle. Labels, headings, buttons and prose never use it.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Numbers that can be compared (prices, durations, counts) use tabular figures and do not wrap.

rules.name: The Heavy Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below weight 500. The hierarchy is 500 / 700 / 800.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. The lift shadow belongs to yellow buttons on hover and to nothing else.

dos: Do keep an element dim (field fill, line border, steel text) until it is set, picked or the action; then light it with `crane`.
Do put `on-crane` text on every yellow or flag-blue fill.
Do set every number, date, time, price and route in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures; set every word of interface in Tajawal.
Do build depth from the three navy layers and 1px `line` borders.
Do use logical properties (inline start and end) for every offset, padding and alignment, and mirror any directional icon or draw-in under RTL.
Do give every control a visible focus ring: yellow on text fields, flag blue on everything else.
Do mark a price as either live (flag-blue tag with source and time) or estimate (dashed tag with source).
Do remove all animation and transition under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't introduce a second warm accent or a third hue; the palette is navy, one yellow, one blue, and coral for errors only.
Don't use yellow as a fill on something that is not selected, recommended or the primary action.
Don't mark more than one option per list as the pick; the yellow border, wash and tag belong to a single recommendation.
Don't set labels, headings, buttons or prose in JetBrains Mono.
Don't set text lighter than weight 500.
Don't add a shadow to a resting surface; the only shadow is the hover lift under a yellow button.
Don't add a light theme; the system is dark only (`color-scheme: dark`).
Don't use physical left and right for layout; the two existing exceptions are deliberate (the English prompt preview and LTR-wrapped times).
